1038     """No-device simulator: voice utterance -> directive round-trip + multimodal envelope.
1039 
1040     Emits the full ReAct trace (thought -> action -> observation -> speak/show)
1041     so the web ReAct visualizer can render the turn without hardware.
1042     """
1043     emit_light_wave("listening")
1044     emit_chime("wake")
1045     _emit_react("thought", f"Heard: {utterance[:140]}", {"utterance": utterance})
1046     directive = _parse_utterance_to_directive(utterance)
1047     if correlation_token:
1048         try:
1049             directive["directive"]["header"]["correlationToken"] = correlation_token
1050         except (KeyError, TypeError):
1051             pass
1052     emit_light_wave("thinking")
1053     header = directive.get("directive", {}).get("header", {})
1054     _emit_react("action", f"{header.get('namespace')}.{header.get('name')}",
1055                 {"directive": directive})
1056     response = handle_directive(directive)
1057     evt_name = response.get("event", {}).get("header", {}).get("name", "Response")
1058     payload = response.get("event", {}).get("payload", {})
1059     if evt_name == "ErrorResponse" and payload.get("type") == "AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED":
1060         speak = "That needs your approval. I staged an approval card for you."
1061         emit_chime("warning")
1062         wave = "alert"
1063     elif evt_name == "ErrorResponse":
1064         speak = f"Sorry, {payload.get('message', 'that did not work.')}"
1065         emit_chime("warning")
1066         wave = "alert"
1067     else:
1068         wave = "speaking"
1069         ns, nm = header.get("namespace", ""), header.get("name", "")

1071             n = len(response.get("event", {}).get("payload", {}).get("endpoints", []))

1073         elif nm in ("TurnOn", "TurnOff"):
1074             speak = "Lights updated."
1075         elif "TargetTemperature" in nm or "ThermostatMode" in nm:

1077         elif nm in ("Lock", "Unlock"):
1078             speak = "Front door locked."
1079         else:
1080             speak = "Done."
1081     _emit_react("observation", f"{evt_name}: {speak[:120]}", {"response": evt_name})
1082     multimodal = build_multimodal_response(speak_text=speak, chime="", light_wave=wave)
